thread:
Incident Bot: AUTOMATED ALERT — 1768123456
Incident Bot: GCP internal LB (ILB) healthcheck failures detected in us-central1 and europe-west1. Elevated 5xx from health-check probes; affects Private VPC customers with cross-region routing enabled. Auto-severity: P1. Pager duty: paged oncall.
Olivia: I'm on it — taking primary. Starting triage now. @Jamal can you pull routing/healthcheck metrics from the console for affected ILBs?
Jamal: pulling metrics. See spikes at 2026-03-12T02:34:00Z. health_check_status ratio dropped to 0.2 for several backends in europe-west1 and us-central1.
Olivia: thanks. Ana, please assemble the initial customer-impact list (which Private VPC customers have traffic routed across those regions).
Ana: on it. Querying product tags and recent routing logs. ETA 10m.
Lee: FYI I checked GCP TCBs — there was a notice about control-plane routing anomalies earlier but it was region-specific. Linking: https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/ILB-control-plane/2026-03-12
GCP Status Bot: [GCP] Investigation: We are seeing internal load balancer health probe failures in europe-west1 and us-central1. Engineers are investigating.
Olivia: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) Temporarily set ILB backend timeout to longer to avoid flapping? 2) Fail open to regional backends (strip cross-region routing) so traffic stays in-region. Which is lower risk?
Jamal: option 2 is safer: remove cross-region enabled routing for impacted customers so their private IPs use nearest regional backends. The change is config-level on Redwood Private control plane — low blast radius if targeted.
Lee: agree. We can push a targeted config rollback for the routing policy for affected customer IDs. Script:
```
# demo only
redwoodctl private routes update --customer-id <ID> --cross-region false --apply-safemode
```
Olivia: Jamal/Lee please coordinate and limit to a small pilot of 3 customers first.
Jamal: starting pilot now for cust-469, cust-172, cust-811. Applying route override to pin to region.
Olivia: Ana please message the three customers via private channels about limited changes and potential short failover windows.
Ana: messaging sent to account reps. Emily, can you join for customer comms framing?
Emily: on it. Draft to accounts: "We're seeing ILB health probe instability in certain GCP regions that may cause cross-region routing interruptions for Private VPC. We're performing a targeted routing change to keep traffic in-region to preserve latency and availability. We'll update with timeline." Send? :thumbsup:
Olivia: send. Jamal, any quick logs from the ILB healthchecks we should attach for engineering and GCP support?
Jamal: attaching snippet. (pasted log block)
```
2026-03-12T02:34:12Z backend healthcheck failed backend=be-12345 region=us-central1 probe_status=5xx
2026-03-12T02:34:14Z backend healthcheck failed backend=be-98765 region=europe-west1 probe_status=502
2026-03-12T02:34:21Z control-plane reconnect attempt failed region=europe-west1
```
Lee: I opened a GCP support case and linked our logs. Case ID: 123456789. Asking for priority escalation citing multi-customer impact.
Olivia: good. Jamal, after pilot if stable, roll remaining affected customers. Use canary batches of 10.
Jamal: pilot completed — pilot customers showed stable traffic after pinning region at 02:49 UTC. Rolling next batch of 10 now.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty: incident 87654 created, escalation policy: infra-sre. Current assignee: Olivia.
Olivia: handoff note for next oncall @Jamal: I'm going offline in 30m for overlap with afternoon shift. Key things: GCP investigating ILB control plane, route-pin mitigation in progress, customer comms sent. Watchlist customers: cust-469, cust-172, cust-811, cust-221, cust-900.
Jamal: ack. I'll monitor and continue batches. If GCP confirms control-plane fix, we will reverse the pinning after a stabilization window.
Ana: GL account messages have started to get replies — cust-469 reported transient 504s before change, now stable. cust-221 still seeing increased latency; investigating if they route through europe-west1.
Lee: running a quick check — one of our internal NAT gateways had excessive conntrack churn in europe-west1, but it's at nominal now. Not sure if that's related.
Olivia: request: collect tokenized metrics for summary (p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate) for before/after for the incident report. Jamal can you pull those?
Jamal: pulling. p95 dropped from 820ms to 220ms for pilot customers after pinning. 5xx rate decreased from 3.2% to 0.1%.
Olivia: good numbers. Emily, prepare a short external blurb for affected customers: timeframe, what we changed, and that we are waiting on GCP control-plane confirmation before rolling back.
Emily: draft ready. Sending to legal for signoff, then to customers.
GCP Status Bot: Update: Root cause suspected — internal health-check proxy in control plane overloaded; engineers deploying mitigations. No ETA on full recovery.
Olivia: Jamal/Lee — keep daily snapshots. If GCP gives ETA we coordinate rollback during low-traffic windows. Also create postmortem tracking ticket.
Jamal: creating postmortem ticket PM-2026-0312 and attaching timeline.
Olivia: handoff to @Jamal now. I'll be available on-call chat for 1 hour if needed.
Jamal: taking over incident. Monitor protocol: check ILB health_check_status, backend 5xx, and region routing flags every 5 min. Revert plan: after GCP confirms 'mitigation in place' and 30m of stable metrics, revert routing pins in 2 small batches and measure.
Ana: compiled customer impact list: 18 Private VPC customers impacted; 5 reported errors publicly, 13 saw latency spike. Severity summary for support: 6 S2, 12 S3.
Olivia: noted. Add to incident header: "Third-party (GCP) control-plane ILB health-check failures — impacted cross-region routing for Private VPC customers." Keep ticket open until normal control-plane health resumes and we revert changes.
GCP Status Bot: Update: Engineers have deployed a mitigative change to the health-check proxy in europe-west1 and us-central1. Monitoring.
Jamal: metrics look stable for 45m post-mitigation. Starting first rollback batch for pinned routes now (5 customers).
Lee: please watch for flapping. Command used:
```
redwoodctl private routes update --customer-ids [ids...] --cross-region true --dry-run=false
```
Jamal: rollback batch 1 completed at 03:59 UTC. Monitoring.
Ana: customer reports: batch1 customers report zero errors after rollback.
Olivia: that's promising. Jamal continue with batch 2 after 15m stable.
Jamal: batch 2 completed at 04:22 UTC. All metrics nominal. Final batch scheduled in 30m.
Emily: sending post-incident update to impacted customers with current state and next steps. Template attached.
Olivia: closing loop: once all routes restored and 60m of stability, we'll declare service restored. Keep incident status updated and start postmortem draft. Kudos to everyone for quick targeted mitigation.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: monitoring. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes.
Olivia: incident handover complete. Leaving note in PM-2026-0312. Jamal, please set owner for postmortem and include timeline, mitigation steps, customer comms, and cost/ops impact.
Jamal: will do. Assigning postmortem owner: Lee (Network Eng). ETA draft: today EOD.
Ana: closing customer notifications thread after final confirmation from batch 3.
Olivia: thanks team. We'll reconvene if GCP re-opens any regressions. :white_check_mark:
